$comment: Two transport-level replies that belong to no request: id is null.
1) A frame whose JSON does not parse (rpc.rs :: respond: {"id": null, "ok": false, "error": "bad JSON: {serde}"};
the serde text names the position, e.g. 'expected value at line 1 column 1').
2) A request line over the 1 MiB ceiling (security.rs MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 1 << 20; stdio keeps
serving, TCP closes after the reply). id: null means a client must NOT resolve any pending
call with these — they are connection-level errors.

reply.error: bad JSON: expected value at line 1 column 1
